landing.headline: Turn Boring Presentations Into Interactive In Seconds
landing.subheadline: Create live polls or quizzes with auto-grading for webinars, seminars, or classes. Your audience just scans a QR from their phone — no app download, no account needed. Optional login only if you want to save your sessions.
landing.joinDesc: Enter the session code from your presenter below:
landing.howItWorksSubtitle: Three simple steps to start an interactive poll
landing.step1Desc: Write your question, choose the answer type (multiple choice / rating / quiz with correct answer), and set the timer.
landing.step2Desc: Display it on the presentation screen. The audience just scans with their phones.
landing.step3Desc: Voting results appear in real-time in a clean chart — for quizzes, a Kahoot-style scoreboard with podium appears automatically.
landing.whySubtitle: Maximum convenience for presenters and participants
landing.feature1Desc: Charts move automatically with every vote, no manual refresh needed.
landing.feature2Desc: The audience just opens their phone camera and scans the QR code to vote.
landing.feature3Desc: The system automatically validates participants so results are 100% fair and accurate.
landing.feature4Desc: High-contrast design ready to look great on projectors and Zoom.
landing.feature5Desc: Support for multiple choice, 1-5 rating scale, and more as needed.
landing.feature6Desc: No email or password needed. Quick entry, maximum participation.
landing.feature7Desc: Correct answers are graded automatically — up to 1000 points per question, faster = higher (Kahoot style).
landing.feature8Desc: Top 3 revealed one by one on a podium with celebration effects, plus the full ranking.
landing.feature9Desc: Save sessions to your account and reopen them anytime. Works fine without login.
landing.ctaTitle: Don't Let Your Presentation Feel Empty Again
landing.ctaDesc: Keep your audience focused and engaged from start to finish. Free forever, no sign-up needed.
landing.mockupQuestion: How efficient is coding with AI?
landing.mySessionsEmpty: You don't have any saved sessions yet.

faqItems.a: Yes, 100% free forever with unlimited usage. No paid plans or participant limits.

faqItems.q: Can I use it on a projector or Zoom?
faqItems.a: Yes. There's a fullscreen presentation mode with high contrast designed for projectors and screenshares.
For MVP, stable for 50-200 active participants per session. Perfect for webinars, classes, and mid-scale seminars.
Each session is protected by a host token, duplicate votes are prevented, and sessions auto-expire after 24 hours.
